description: Evaluation set for requirement extraction (Opportunity agent and keyword fallback). expected_required = skills the posting requires. Postings are written for evaluation and are not real vacancies.

postings.text:
AI/ML Engineering Intern - Nimbus Analytics
Required: strong Python and experience with model evaluation (metrics, cross-validation).
Required: SQL for pulling training data.
Nice to have: Git.

Machine Learning Research Intern
You must be comfortable with Python and deep learning frameworks.
Writing clear technical reports is a plus.

Data Analyst Intern, Harbor Retail
Mandatory: SQL and basic statistics.
Preferred: data visualisation tools.

ML Platform Intern
Required skills: Python, Docker and day-to-day Linux.
Bonus: experience with cloud deployments.

Backend Developer Intern
Must know Java and core data structures.
Git experience desirable.

Frontend Engineering Intern
Required: JavaScript and React.
Nice to have: accessibility knowledge.

Quantitative Research Intern
Essential: Python and statistics.
You need hands-on model evaluation and backtesting experience.

Applied AI Intern - robotics perception
Required: C++ and deep learning for vision.
Python is a plus.

Open-source ML Fellowship
You must contribute in Python and work through Git pull requests.
Technical writing is a bonus.

Analytics Engineering Intern
Required: SQL and data visualisation dashboards.
Preferred: Python scripting.
